info.title: SkyDispatch server API
info.description: The API the Android app uses. Every route is under `/api/v1`. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <device token>` from `POST /api/v1/pair`. Errors are `{"error": "message"}`. Routes other than the ones with explicit schemas return JSON shaped for display (preformatted text for units and money).

409.description: A career exists; send confirm_reset=true to replace it

post.summary: Trade the one-time code from the QR for a device token
post.description: Send the header `X-SkyDispatch: 1`. Wrong codes are rate limited (5 per minute per address).

get.summary: Is this a SkyDispatch server, and is my token still accepted?

speech_output.description: Where speech is heard: the PC's speakers, or this phone (see the `speech` event)

get.summary: Server-sent events: live telemetry and updates
get.description: `text/event-stream`. Events: `state` (telemetry, about every 0.45 s), `sim_status`, `ai_status`, `toast`, `thread`, `busy`, `settings`, `career`, `plan`. Optional `v=<8-64 chars [A-Za-z0-9_-]>` names this viewer so speech is only produced while someone is looking at a conversation. When `speech_output` is `phone` the stream also carries `speech` (`{id, thread, text, voice, speed, audio}`: say `text`; if `audio` is true fetch `GET /voice/audio/{id}` and play it, otherwise use the phone's own voice) and `speech_stop` (`{keep: [threads]}`: stop speech for any other conversation; an empty list stops everything).

post.summary: Remove this phone from the server (its token stops working)

get.summary: The spoken audio for a `speech` event
get.description: Rendered on first request (can take a moment) and then kept for ten minutes.

503.description: This PC cannot make audio for that voice; speak the event's `text` with the phone's own voice

post.summary: Turn a recording of the player's voice into text
post.description: Body: a PCM16 `.wav` (mono or stereo, 8-96 kHz; 16 kHz mono is ideal), at most 2 MB. With `send` the text is also said in that conversation, as if typed. Recognition runs on the PC and can take a few seconds.

400.description: Not a usable .wav, or an unknown conversation

503.description: Speech recognition is not installed or is switched off on the PC; use the phone's own recogniser and post the text to /thread/{tid}/send

Unauthorized.description: Missing, wrong or revoked device token

NoCareer.description: There is no career yet; create one with POST /api/v1/career

token.description: Keep this secret on the phone; send it as the bearer token.

confirm_reset.description: Required to replace an existing career
